async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Locate the search box under complementary -> search
    search_box = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search")
    await search_box.fill("GPT")
    
    # Step 2: Click the search button
    search_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    await search_button.click()
    
    # Step 3: Wait for the search results page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Additional wait for UI to update
    
    # Step 4: Click the third search result
    # Get all links on the page that are likely search results
    all_links = page.get_by_role("link")
    link_count = await all_links.count()
    if link_count >= 3:
        third_link = all_links.nth(2)  # Zero-indexed, third link
        await third_link.click()
    else:
        raise Exception(f"Only {link_count} links found, need at least 3 for third result.")

async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Locate the search box under complementary -> search
    search_box = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search")
    await search_box.fill("GPT")

    # Step 2: Click the search button
    search_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    await search_button.click()

    # Step 3: Wait for the search results page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Additional wait for UI to update

    # Step 4: Click the third search result
    # Get all links on the page that are likely search results
    all_links = page.get_by_role("link")
    link_count = await all_links.count()
    if link_count >= 3:
        third_link = all_links.nth(2)  # Zero-indexed, third link
        await third_link.click()
    else:
        raise Exception(f"Only {link_count} links found, need at least 3 for third result.")
    return link_count
